SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
FROM orderexecutions oe
JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
WHERE oe.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
  AND oe.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
GROUP BY u.acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: Expiry values are stored in a timestamp-compatible format, so comparing them to these strings uses chronological timestamp ordering as intended.
